name: House Party
summary: Social puzzle-comedy sandbox set at a chaotic suburban party where every NPC follows schedules, reacts to inventory hijinks, and unlocks custom stories.
ranking_rationale: Brings classic point-and-click puzzle comedy into a 3D branching sandbox with Steam Workshop custom stories; note explicit uncensor patch is separate from base Steam install.

pricing.notes: Base game sold on Steam; official free/paid Explicit Patch available via Eek! Games website.

pros: Reacts hilariously to weird item combinations and multi-NPC dialogue chains
Rich Steam Workshop & Custom Story Creator extends replayability
Full voice acting and guest celebrity DLCs (Doja Cat, Game Grumps)
cons: Requires downloading the separate explicit patch from developer's site to remove censors
2010s Unity animations show their age close up

image.alt: House Party logo and brand card

facts.value: Steam release ships censored; explicit patch distributed externally
